profile.headline: SWE @ Electronic Arts
profile.geoLocationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built and deployed a full-stack web server to monitor user path scenarios and server performance, using MySQL, .NET Razor Pages, and C#. Resulted in a live monitoring platform that tracked path statistics by game title and improved stress test reliability.
 
Selected to speak on an intern panel for EA’s STEAM Camp, sharing insights on career development and technology with aspiring students.

Served as an Intern Squad Leader, coordinating peer initiatives and organizing an Intern Arcade Outing to strengthen community and collaboration among interns.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: - Tasked with developing a data health visualization dashboard for file tracking using Snowflake, Datadog, and Databricks.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Utilized Azure DevOps and agile development framework to track project progress.
- Build a digital platform to track carbon emissions of a sub-company oil processes amongst 6 Business Units utilizing Power Bi.
- Utilized Azure Databricks and PysparkSQL to perform transformations and visualizations (Databricks Notebooks) on datasets.
- Effectively communicated and executed project goals and expectations directly with sub-company stakeholders while developing
business fluency skill set.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps Services · Azure SQL · Microsoft Power BI · Azure Databricks

positions.title: Student Intern (Information System Services)
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Assist in maintaining Cyber Security Policies and Practices
- Build basic web pages using HTML/CSS for internal company employee phishing training 
- Complete various work projects utilizing Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel
- Created network flow diagrams using Visio
- Gained exposure to Nessus and Elastic software
- Communicate and work effectively in a team environment
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Tenable Nessus · Microsoft Office · Network Security
